featureCoverage.notes: Create, open, and import upstream workspaces through the shared application service.
Local recovery points and restore. Existing Git remotes are not rewritten.
First-party slice is block, item, recipe, and procedure only.
Living entities and other upstream types are outside the first-party slice. See elementCoverage: imported types stay read-only; create/update are rejected.
Asset graph and Blockbench round trip exist. Fabric 1.21.1 runClient loaded file/copper_ready_pack.zip in ResourceManager.
First-party local MCP with read_only, workspace, and full_access profiles.
First-party Fabric/NeoForge generate for all four tracks.
Gradle build tasks exist. Offline cached 1.21.1 builds exist. Fabric and NeoForge 26.2, 26.1.2, and 1.20.1 compile probes produced jars.
runClient evidence exists for Fabric/NeoForge 26.2, 26.1.2, 1.21.1, and 1.20.1.
Structured diagnostics and reason codes are shared by UI, MCP, and headless.
Copy-only same-version Fabric↔NeoForge migration. Source trees stay unchanged.
Publish batches export ZIP and prepare run/resourcepacks without auto-launching. Fabric 1.21.1 ResourceManager listed file/copper_ready_pack.zip.
Playwright help/About/DPI/hit-test is 100/100. Real JCEF product-shell reported React chrome regions, native HTMAXBUTTON=9 Snap hit-test, and WM_DPICHANGED 144 (DPR 1.5).
Java plugins are opt-in full trust. Swing UI plugins stay in a legacy window. list_installed_plugins returns the live first-party and user plugin inventory without loading Java.
Remote MCP is out of first-release scope.
Linux and macOS installers are out of first-release scope.
Windows 10 is out of first-release scope. The supported desktop is Windows 11 x64.
Accounts, cloud sync, and vendor chat are out of first-release scope.
Unsigned GitHub Releases are the first public distribution. Authenticode is optional and not a release gate. jsign 7.4 stays wired.
Windows 11 Hyper-V guest silent install/upgrade/uninstall preserved workspace and .copperbench. Guest copperbench.exe stay-alive is not claimed.

developmentFocus.reason: Public identity is Copperbench. Distribution is an unsigned GPL GitHub fork with no product website. Authenticode is out of first-release scope. G7 is not passed: Hyper-V guest GUI stay-alive is not claimed.

knownLimitations.message: Windows 10 is not a supported platform. First release targets Windows 11 x64 only.
The Windows 11 Hyper-V guest completed silent install, upgrade, and uninstall with the NIC disconnected. copperbench.exe did not remain running for 10 seconds, so guest GUI stay-alive is not claimed.
First public binaries are unsigned GitHub Releases. jsign 7.4 remains wired if Authenticode secrets are added later; SmartScreen may warn. This is policy, not a pending certificate.

Copperbench is the public product name. There is no product domain, store listing, or trademark campaign. Support is the public GitHub repository. Product ID dev.copperbench.studio is a reverse-DNS identifier, not a live website.
prepare_resource_pack_client writes run/resourcepacks and options.txt and does not launch Minecraft. Fabric 1.21.1 runClient listed file/copper_ready_pack.zip in ResourceManager.
Third-party plugins are classified A/B/C/X. Unsupported plugins are not claimed as supported.
The cached-dependency build uses Gradle --offline after a cache-warm, not an OS-level network disconnect.
The official Stage 8 cached-dependency --offline claim remains Fabric and NeoForge 1.21.1. 26.x probes recorded their own cache-warm/--offline jars separately.
